verdict: This raid HUD is readable and mostly lower case, but the centre column stacks four unrelated banners and every corner uses a different panel style, so the eye has no clear first stop and the 'p2 pad lost' alert barely registers.

findings.where: top-centre and centre banner stack (team score, extract, chill row, golden enemy, stronghold, p2 pad lost)
findings.what: Six separate pills and labels pile up in one column. 'p2 pad lost' is the only actionable alert on this screen, yet it is a small amber chip at the bottom of the pile, and it sits in the same visual slot as the two informational banners above it. The same 'golden enemy' and 'stronghold' messages also repeat in the bottom-left toast list, so each appears twice. This is clutter.
findings.fix: Show each message once. Drop the centre 'golden enemy' and 'stronghold' pills, since the toasts already carry them. Make 'p2 pad lost' a single 20px f-cond 600 line in --warn on a --ui-panel pill, with a 3px --warn left bar, at about 30% screen height, and keep nothing else near it.

findings.what: The hero element (0 sp) is about 36px, 'you 0 sp / p2 0 sp' is tiny and dim, and the timer 9:57 is almost as large as the score. The block is also cut off by the top edge with no top margin. The extract chip below it is a different fill and sits half outside the block, so it reads as two misaligned boxes.
findings.fix: Use --fs-hero 56px for one number only (the timer or the score, not both). Set the split lines to 16px tx-2. Put 16px of padding above the block, and put the extract chip inside the same panel as a footer row with a 1px --ui-line divider.

findings.where: HUD panels: run info top-right, ammo bottom-right, hotbar, status bars bottom-left, map
findings.what: Every panel is different. Run info is a flat dark box with a chevron, ammo is a translucent box with a border and an accent tab, the hotbar is a rounded dark slab, and the toasts have a white left tick. Corner radii and fills do not match the one-panel rule (--ui-panel at 90%, 1px --ui-line-hi, 4px radius). The 'player 2' tag, 'standing' and the 'keyboard' badge are also three unrelated chip styles.
findings.fix: Use one panel component everywhere: fill #16191b at 90%, 1px #4a5257 border, 4px radius, 16px padding, and no gradient. Reserve the 3px lime left tab for the one star panel, which is the ammo block.

findings.what: The three bars use three different colours (blue, steel and green), and their text is at three different sizes and weights. 'hp 100' is much bigger than armour and stamina and is drawn directly on the bar fill with low contrast. The bars are crowded against the bottom edge, with about 12px of margin against a 5% rule, and stamina's label is dark text over dark fill.
findings.fix: Make all three bars 20px tall with 16px f-cond 600 labels placed outside the fill, in tx-1. Keep hp as the only large figure, at 32px. Use a 5% (54px) bottom and left margin, and an 8px gap between bars.

findings.where: toast list left (easy mode on / stronghold / golden enemy) and the 'the seal 0%' world label
findings.what: The toasts are small 16px type with a hard white tick and an info glyph on every row, so three rows look like noise. The 'the seal 0%' label is a teal world label that is dim and low contrast against the grey-purple ground, and it sits near the map edge with no anchor. 'chill row cache' in pink-purple is a different text colour from every other label and uses a colour outside the palette.
findings.fix: Cap the toast list at one or two rows and drop the info glyph. Use tx-1 at 16px on --ui-panel pills. Make the zone name tx-1 with a text shadow, and use --extract teal only for the extraction elements. Remove the pink-purple colour.

findings.where: hotbar labels ('auto rifle  fire  use') above the hotbar
findings.what: The weapon name, 'fire' and 'use' are three loose labels at about 14px, jammed together with uneven gaps and sitting directly on top of the hotbar edge. 'fire' is highlighted as if it were a button, but it is not a button, so it is confusing. They are also nearly invisible against the busy ground.
findings.fix: Put the weapon name only in the ammo panel (it already says 'auto rifle'). Keep one key-hint row at 16px tx-2 inside a panel pill, 8px above the hotbar, and make the focused hint the only item in tx-1.

findings.where: hotbar slots and ammo panel (bottom right)
findings.what: The slots are very dim, and the empty ones have the same fill as the filled ones. The selected slot is outlined in amber/gold, not the lime accent, so focus is not consistent with the style guide. The purple 'rb 150' slot has a different border and fill again. The 'auto rifle' title at the top of the ammo panel is small, and the dark tab and the 25 / 150 numbers are crowded to the bottom-right corner.
findings.fix: Use a 2px --acc outline for the selected slot only, and a 1px --ui-line border for the others. Dim empty slots to 40% opacity and give filled ones full opacity. Rarity should show as a 3px bar at the bottom of the slot, not a purple fill. Give the ammo panel 24px padding and 54px margins.

findings.what: 'run info' and 'run goals' are two heading lines at nearly the same size, one dim, so the hierarchy is unclear. The goals list has a ragged left indent, and the panel is wedged against the minimap with no gap, so the minimap border and the panel border touch. The chevron is a tiny target.
findings.fix: Keep one 16px tx-2 heading ('run goals'), set the goal rows at 20px tx-1 with the sp amounts right-aligned in tx-2, and leave an 8px gap under the minimap. Align the panel's left edge with the minimap's left edge.
